param_input_item.param_description: Seed of the pseudo-random generator (default 0). The same seed reproduces the same field.

param_output_item.param_description: An n-by-2 [x y] point set sampling the attractor.

description.p: Sample a self-similar fractal attractor with the chaos game: starting from a point, repeatedly apply a randomly chosen affine map of an iterated function system. 'fern' reproduces Barnsley's fern, 'sierpinski' the Sierpinski triangle.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: P = tessera.chaos_game(60000, 'fern', 1); plot(P(:, 1), P(:, 2), '.', 'MarkerSize', 1); axis equal off
